base_member_text: [L163,L176,L184,L190,L198,L328-L342] (MED/error-propagation) Detected storage errors terminate through plain STOP without returning an error or signaling assertion failure, which can appear as successful process termination.
audit_member_text: [L160-L163,L173-L176,L181-L198,L328-L342] (MED/failure-signaling) Detected open and format failures use bare STOP, which normally exits successfully and can make a failed test-data load appear successful to a process-level test runner.

adversarial.rationale: Storage errors call bare STOP without a status argument, assertion hook, or error result in the public interfaces. A restart-aware ftnunit driver may later recognize an interrupted test, but a runner using only the immediate process exit status can still see normal termination after a failed load.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex gpt-6-astra skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L53-L59,L158,L245-L246,L491-L492,L737-L738] (LOW/format-portability) The fixed format identifier records no kind widths, byte order or record-marker format even though payloads use compiler-native unformatted representations.
audit_member_text: [L50-L59,L158,L245,L491,L737] (LOW/serialization-contract) The fixed format version records default-kind binary values without recording their widths, endianness, or record-marker format, leaving cross-compiler and compiler-option compatibility unspecified.

base_member_text: [L166-L168,L245-L246,L345,L383-L385,L1582,L1723] (MED/io-error-handling) Payload reads and all writes lack IOSTAT handling despite metadata-read checks, so truncated payloads or write failures bypass the module's controlled diagnostics.
audit_member_text: [L166-L168,L245-L246,L345,L385,L1629,L1723] (MED/io-error-handling) Payload reads and all writes omit IOSTAT handling, so truncated data or output failures abort in the runtime instead of producing a controlled storage error.

adversarial.rationale: The opening/header and per-record metadata checks do not cover the subsequent payload read, and writes throughout the serializers have no IOSTAT/ERR handler. A valid metadata record followed by a missing payload therefore bypasses the custom diagnostic branches and raises a Fortran runtime I/O error.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex gpt-6-astra skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L539-L545,L684-L689,L709] (HIGH/serialization-type-mismatch) The rank-three real writer serializes dimensions as REAL while its reader interprets them as INTEGER, producing invalid extents and potentially enormous allocations on ordinary round trips.
audit_member_text: [L539-L545,L684-L709] (HIGH/serialization-type-mismatch) The three-dimensional real writer serializes dimensions as REAL while its reader interprets them as INTEGER, corrupting array extents and potentially causing enormous allocations.

adversarial.rationale: The public generic dispatch includes the rank-three REAL writer and reader; the file is explicitly opened unformatted, so no formatted numeric conversion can reconcile REAL dimensions at L539 with INTEGER dimensions at L684. For the usual four-byte representation, even extent 1.0 has integer bit pattern 1065353216, which passes the separate type/rank checks before allocation.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex gpt-6-astra skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L383,L423,L463,L629,L669,L709,L875,L915,L955,L1121,L1161,L1201,L1367,L1407,L1447,L1627,L1674,L1721] (MED/allocation-validation) Array readers allocate directly from file extents without checking negative values, reasonable size limits or allocation status.
audit_member_text: [L363-L385,L403-L425,L443-L465,L609-L631,L689-L711,L1694-L1723] (MED/metadata-validation) Array readers validate type and rank but allocate directly from unchecked file extents, allowing negative dimensions to become empty arrays or excessive dimensions to terminate allocation.

adversarial.rationale: Every examined array reader checks metadata I/O status, type and rank, but then allocates directly from dimensions without extent validation or STAT. Writers normally derive valid dimensions from shape(data), but corrupted/external records and the rank-three REAL serialization mismatch still reach these allocations through a valid header and rank.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex gpt-6-astra skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check
